title: R' Panda
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Berakhot 55b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.55b.16): R' Akiva said in the name of R' Panda, who said in the name of R' Nahum; and Dikdukei Soferim brings several readings: R' Panana, or R' Parna.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: In the longer chain in the Bavli, Rabbi Akiva cites Rabbi Panda, who cites Rav Nahum. [Heilprin’s Panda notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2957&lang=en) gives Tanchum in the last position of this excerpt.

[Dikdukei Soferim, p. 304, note 8](https://www.google.com/books/edition/_/ZWuq1txyjt8C?hl=en&gbpv=1&pg=RA1-PA304) compares variant forms and different orders for the chain. Hyman cites Panana and Parna as alternatives.
Hyman’s abbreviated titles are retained. The name variants leave the exact identity of the transmitters open.
